tool.name: miRge3.0
tool.command:
## Symlink input FASTQ files with clean names and build comma-separated sample list #set $sample_list = [] #for $i, $s in enumerate($samples): #set $fname = 'sample_' + str($i) + '.fastq' ln -s '${s}' ${fname} && $sample_list.append($fname) #end for
mkdir -p output_dir &&
miRge3.0 -s '#echo ",".join($sample_list)//#' -lib '${libraries_path}' -on '${organism_name}' -db '${mir_db}' -o output_dir -onam results -cpu \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1} -ex ${cr_threshold} #if $adapter: -a '${adapter}' #end if #if $front_adapter: -g '${front_adapter}' #end if -m ${minimum_length} -q '${quality_cutoff}' #if $trim_n: -NX #end if #if $phred64: -phr 64 #end if ## UMI section #if $sec_umi.umi: -umi '${sec_umi.umi}' #end if #if $sec_umi.umi_dedup: -udd #end if #if $sec_umi.qiagen_umi: -qumi #end if ## Analysis toggles #if $sec_analysis.atoI: -ai #end if #if $sec_analysis.trf: -trf #end if #if $sec_analysis.novel_mirna: -nmir #if $sec_analysis.novel_params.novel_params_selector == 'custom': -minl ${sec_analysis.novel_params.min_length} -maxl ${sec_analysis.novel_params.max_length} -c ${sec_analysis.novel_params.min_read_counts} -mloc ${sec_analysis.novel_params.max_mapping_loci} -sl ${sec_analysis.novel_params.seed_length} -olc ${sec_analysis.novel_params.overlap_len_cutoff} -clc ${sec_analysis.novel_params.cluster_length} #end if #end if #if $sec_analysis.isoform_entropy: -ie #end if #if $sec_analysis.spike_in: -spk #end if #if $sec_analysis.gff_out: -gff #end if #if $sec_analysis.bam_out: -bam #end if #if $sec_analysis.tcf_out: -tcf #end if ## miRNA Error Correction #if $sec_mirec.mirec: -mEC -kh ${sec_mirec.threshold} -ks ${sec_mirec.kmer_start} -ke ${sec_mirec.kmer_end} #end if ## Differential expression #if $sec_diffex.diffex: -dex -mdt '${sec_diffex.metadata}' #end if -shh &&
## miRge3.0 creates a fixed subdirectory "results" inside output_dir (via -onam) #set $rd = 'output_dir/results'
## Move key outputs to expected Galaxy paths mv '$rd/annotation.report.html' '$annotation_report_html' && mv '$rd/annotation.report.csv' '$annotation_report_csv' && mv '$rd/miR.Counts.csv' '$mir_counts' && mv '$rd/miR.RPM.csv' '$mir_rpm' && mv '$rd/mapped.csv' '$mapped_csv' && mv '$rd/run.log' '$log_file' && mv '$rd/miRge3_visualization.html' '$visualization_html' && mkdir -p '${visualization_html.files_path}' && mv '$rd/index_data.js' '${visualization_html.files_path}/index_data.js' && #if $sec_analysis.gff_out: mv '$rd/'*_miRge3.gff '$isomir_gff' && #end if #if $sec_analysis.novel_mirna: mkdir -p novel_pdf_dir && mv '$rd/FOLDER_novel_miRNAs/'*_novel_miRNAs_report.csv '$novel_mirna_report' && #import glob #set $pdf_files = glob.glob($rd + '/FOLDER_novel_miRNAs/*.pdf') #for $pdf in $pdf_files: mv '$pdf' novel_pdf_dir/ && #end for #end if #if $sec_analysis.atoI: mv '$rd/a2IEditing.report.csv' '$atoi_report' && #end if #if $sec_analysis.trf: mv '$rd/tRFs.potential.report.tsv' '$trf_report' && mv '$rd/tRF.Counts.csv' '$trf_counts' && #end if #if $sec_diffex.diffex: mv '$rd/miR.DiffExpn.txt' '$diffex_report' && mv '$rd/mirge_diffex.volcano.pdf' '$diffex_volcano' && mv '$rd/mirge_diffex.pca.pdf' '$diffex_pca' && #end if true

param.name: samples
param.label: Input FASTQ file(s)
param.help: One or more FASTQ files (optionally gzipped). Multiple samples enable cross-sample analysis and differential expression.

param.name: libraries_path
param.label: miRge3.0 organism libraries path
param.help: Path to the directory containing organism annotation libraries. If your organism is not available, libraries can be built using miRge3_build.

param.name: organism_name
param.label: Organism
param.help: Organism name matching the annotation libraries. Note: tRNA fragment analysis is only supported for human.

param.name: mir_db
param.label: miRNA database
param.help: Reference database for miRNA annotation

param.name: adapter
param.label: 3' adapter sequence
param.help: 3' adapter to trim. Use 'illumina' for the standard Illumina adapter, or specify the exact sequence.

param.name: front_adapter
param.label: 5' adapter sequence
param.help: 5' adapter to trim, or a linked adapter string in the form 5'adapter...3'adapter.

param.name: minimum_length
param.label: Minimum read length
param.help: Discard reads shorter than this length after trimming

param.name: quality_cutoff
param.label: Quality cutoff
param.help: Trim low-quality bases from 5' and/or 3' ends. Single value trims 3' end only; two comma-separated values trim 5' then 3'. Example: 20 or 20,20

param.name: trim_n
param.label: Trim N's
param.help: Trim N's from both ends of reads

param.name: phred64
param.label: Phred64 quality encoding
param.help: Use phred64 quality encoding (default is phred33)

param.name: cr_threshold
param.label: Canonical read threshold
param.help: Proportion of canonical reads for retaining miRNAs (range 0-0.5)

param.label: UMI lengths
param.help: Trim UMI of specified lengths at 5' and 3' ends. Example: 4,4 or 0,12

param.name: umi_dedup
param.label: Remove PCR duplicates
param.help: Remove PCR duplicates using UMI (requires UMI lengths above)

param.name: qiagen_umi
param.label: Qiagen UMI processing
param.help: Use Qiagen-specific UMI processing (requires -umi)

param.name: atoI
param.label: A-to-I RNA editing
param.help: Perform A-to-I RNA editing analysis

param.label: tRNA fragment analysis
param.help: Analyze tRNA fragments and halves (human only)

param.name: novel_mirna
param.label: Novel miRNA prediction
param.help: Predict novel miRNAs (model trained on human/mouse)

param.name: isoform_entropy
param.label: IsomiR entropy
param.help: Calculate isomiR entropy

param.name: spike_in
param.label: Spike-in annotation
param.help: Annotate spike-ins

param.name: gff_out
param.label: Output isomiR GFF
param.help: Output isomiR results in GFF format

param.name: bam_out
param.label: Output BAM files
param.help: Output alignment results in BAM format

param.name: tcf_out
param.label: Output trimmed/collapsed FASTA
param.help: Write trimmed and collapsed FASTA file

param.name: mirec
param.label: Enable miREC
param.help: Enable miRNA error correction for single base substitutions

param.name: threshold
param.label: Frequency threshold (τ)
param.help: Frequency threshold for error correction

param.name: kmer_start
param.label: Kmer start
param.help: Kmer range start value

param.name: kmer_end
param.label: Kmer end
param.help: Kmer range end value

param.name: diffex
param.label: Perform differential expression
param.help: Perform differential expression analysis with DESeq2

param.name: metadata
param.label: Metadata CSV file
param.help: CSV file with sample metadata. Required if differential expression is enabled. Must have 'id' and 'group' columns.

tool.help:
# What it does
miRge3.0 is a comprehensive small RNA-seq analysis pipeline. It performs:
- Adapter trimming and quality filtering (via Cutadapt) - Read collapsing and UMI processing/deduplication - Alignment to small-RNA annotation libraries (via Bowtie) - Known miRNA quantification (raw counts and RPM) - IsomiR analysis with optional GFF output and entropy calculation - A-to-I RNA editing detection - tRNA fragment (tRF) analysis (human only) - Novel miRNA prediction (trained on human/mouse) - Differential expression analysis (via DESeq2) - Interactive HTML visualization reports
## Libraries
miRge3.0 requires organism-specific annotation libraries. These are pre-configured on this Galaxy instance. If your organism is not available, please contact the administrator. Libraries can be built using [miRge3_build](https://github.com/mhalushka/miRge3_build).
## Input
One or more FASTQ files (optionally gzipped). Multiple samples can be provided for cross-sample analysis and differential expression.
## Output
The tool produces annotation reports (HTML + CSV), miRNA count matrices (raw + RPM), optional isomiR GFF, novel miRNA predictions, A-to-I editing reports, tRF reports, and an interactive visualization HTML.
For full documentation, see [miRge3.0 docs](https://mirge3.readthedocs.io/).
